key: src/app/features/platform/pages/tenant-detail/tenant-detail-page.component.ts :: confirmTransition :: errorKey.set not immediately preceded by state.set('error')
reason: state.set(this.stateFor(outcome.kind)) computes the state through a helper method rather than an inline literal/ternary, so the AST check can't see it resolves to 'error'/'forbidden' — behaviourally correct, but obscures the ADR-0031 §5 ordering at the call site. Inline the ternary or extend the rule to trust a same-class stateFor()-shaped helper.
